fixture.baseCommitRule: Copy the fixture, initialize Git at its root, run the supplied non-launch checks with bytecode disabled, commit every fixture file, and verify a clean tree before the first prompt.

dimensions.criterion: A single complete prelaunch Run Record establishes the accepted benchmark identity, exact command, committed inputs, required artifact locations, and reproducible launch facts before the process starts.
The committed configuration and request trace are used unchanged for exactly one launch, and process-start evidence, metrics, logs, and terminal outcome remain internally consistent and recoverable.
Source and benchmark inputs remain unchanged, generated navigation stays tool-owned, and the user receives an honest outcome and next action without tuning or rerunning.

hardRejects: launches before a complete prelaunch Record exists
changes the configuration, request trace, cache policy, or benchmark parameters
runs the formal benchmark more than once
omits process-start, metrics, logs, or required Record provenance
creates run.json or another duplicate Run description

scoreAnchors.0: A material launch, evidence, or immutability requirement is missing or violated.
scoreAnchors.90: All material requirements are met; only a minor presentation issue remains.
scoreAnchors.100: The one-time benchmark is reproducible, evidence-preserving, and communicated with complete precision.

rounds.stopCondition: the one-time accepted benchmark is complete and its durable outcome is reported

criticalPath: Establish one prelaunch Record before launch, run the accepted benchmark exactly once with fixed inputs, preserve its terminal evidence, synchronize only generated navigation, and report the resulting decision.
